map.违法解除赔偿金计算器（2N） 使用指南: Illegal Termination Compensation Calculator (2N) User Guide
map.输入工作年限与月工资，按经济补偿标准二倍计算违法解除赔偿金（2N），辅助劳动仲裁: Enter the years of service and monthly wage to compute the illegal termination compensation (2N) as twice the statutory economic compensation standard, supporting labour arbitration calculations.
map.填写「当地社平工资3倍（元/月）」。: Enter "three times the local average social wage (CNY per month)".
map.用人单位违法解除/终止劳动合同，劳动者不要求继续履行的，测算 2N 赔偿金。: When an employer unlawfully terminates the labour contract and the employee does not require continued performance, calculate the 2N compensation.
map.N 按工作年限确定，高薪者基数与年限双封顶。: N is set by years of service, with both the wage base and the years capped for high earners.
map.提示 2N 已含经济补偿部分，不另行支付 N。: Note that 2N already includes the economic compensation portion, so no separate N is paid.
map.：工作 15 年、基数封顶社平 3 倍（3.5 万）、年限封顶 12：赔偿金 =: : With 15 years of service, the base capped at 3 times the average social wage (35000) and the years capped at 12: compensation = 35000 × 12 × 2 = 840,000 CNY.
map.2N 和 N+1 能同时要吗？: Can I Claim Both 2N and N+1?
map.不能。违法解除适用 2N；合法无过失辞退未提前通知才适用 N+1，二者择一。: No. Illegal termination uses 2N; N+1 applies only to a lawful dismissal without fault and without notice, and the two are alternatives.
map.继续履行和 2N 怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between Continued Performance and 2N?
map.劳动者可选择要求继续履行合同，或选择不继续履行而主张 2N 赔偿金；具体看职位可: An employee may choose to require continued performance of the contract, or to stop performance and claim 2N compensation; it depends on how replaceable the position is and the individual's wishes.
